title: Upper bounds on the number of causal pieces in spiking neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.22484v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The input space of single-spike neural networks decomposes into causal pieces, and the number of causal pieces has been shown to provide a lower bound on the approximation error for some spiking neural networks. While this decomposition is applicable to a wide range of spiking neuron models, the limits of how many causal pieces can be realised by spiking neural networks are still unknown. In this work, we derive two complementary upper bounds on the number of causal pieces in feedforward single-spike neural networks. First, we establish a combinatorial bound given by the poly-Bernoulli numbers, which applies to a broad class of spiking neuron models. translated_title: 脉冲神经网络中因果片段数量的上界
translated_abstract: 单脉冲神经网络的输入空间可以分解为因果片段，并且对于某些脉冲神经网络，因果片段的数量已被证明可以提供逼近误差的下界。虽然这种分解适用于广泛的脉冲神经元模型，但脉冲神经网络所能实现的因果片段数量的极限仍然未知。在这项工作中，我们推导了前馈单脉冲神经网络中因果片段数量的两个互补上界。首先，我们建立了一个由多重伯努利数给出的组合界，该界适用于一大类脉冲神经元模型，其阶为 $e^{2(L-1)N\log N+\mathcal{O}(N)}$，其中 $L$ 为网络深度，$N$ 为最大层宽。其次，对于一组特定的神经元模型，我们推导了一个基于超平面排列的界。应用后一种框架，我们得到了阶为 $\mathcal{O}\!\left(N^{(4L...}\right)$ 的界（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本文首次为前馈单脉冲神经网络中因果片段的数量推导出两个互补的上界——一个基于多重伯努利数、适用于广泛脉冲神经元模型的组合界，以及一个基于超平面排列的界，从而填补了脉冲神经网络因果片段数量极限研究的空白。
en_tdlr: This work derives the first two complementary upper bounds on the number of causal pieces in feedforward single-spike neural networks: a combinatorial bound via poly-Bernoulli numbers applicable to a broad class of spiking neuron models, and a hyperplane arrangement bound for specific neuron models.
